import subprocess,pathlib,datetime
roots=[str(pathlib.Path.home()/x) for x in ['Desktop','Movies','Documents','Downloads']]
r=subprocess.run(['rg','--files','--hidden',*roots,'-g','*.mp4','-g','*.mov','-g','*.webm','-g','!node_modules','-g','!.git','-g','!.local'],capture_output=True,text=True)
a=[]
for x in r.stdout.splitlines():
 try:
  s=pathlib.Path(x).stat()
  if s.st_size>100000000 and s.st_mtime>datetime.datetime(2026,10,19).timestamp():a.append((s.st_mtime,s.st_size,x))
 except OSError:pass
for t,size,x in sorted(a,reverse=True)[:15]:print(datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(t),size,x)
